name: spreadsheetSetRowHidden
description: Hides or shows a row without deleting its data.

params.name: hide
params.description: true to hide the row, false to show it.

rustcfml.notes: Not supported on wasm32. The third argument is named hidden (default true). Member forms: setRowHidden(row, hidden), hideRow(row), showRow(row), isRowHidden(row).

examples.title: Hide a row
examples.description: Hide row 3 and check its hidden state.
